ideas.pitch: A hybrid IoT sensor node and software dashboard providing real-time soil analytics and autonomous valve control using offline mesh networks for remote farmlands.
ideas.title: AgriMesh Hybrid: LoRa-Enabled Smart Irrigation and Soil Health Monitoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a physical hardware prototype with software dashboards, fitting the exact Hardware + Software mandate of VYOM while mirroring the mesh-network and offline resilience focus of winning projects like HACKATHON-prahari-link-TEAM-SB.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic local resource governor and vibration anomaly detector that monitors industrial motors and triggers emergency shutoffs without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: Industrial Edge Guard: Anomaly Detection on Arduino Ventuno for Machine Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering and deterministic edge-processing directly on hardware components, satisfying engineering judges who appreciate functional local safety systems.

ideas.pitch: A dual-component system featuring ESP32-based GPS and ultrasonic passenger counters on campus shuttles feeding a live prediction engine for students.
ideas.title: Campus Transit Dispatcher: IoT Bus Tracker and Crowd Density Estimator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus logistics pain point for the organizers and students attending Government College of Engineering, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

ideas.pitch: An embedded computer vision classification mechanism integrated with a sorting conveyor prototype to automatically segregate dry and wet waste.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI: Low-Power Edge Garbage Segregation Prototype
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly links hardware actuation with computer vision classification, leveraging proven concepts from past robotics hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent telemetry framework monitoring hazardous gas levels, temperature anomalies, and power fluctuations in institutional chemistry and engineering labs.
ideas.title: LabGuard IoT: Autonomous Multi-Sensor Laboratory Safety and Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements automated diagnostic responses and alerts, matching the multi-agent operational rigor found in winning IoT operations solutions.
